## Updraft 0.8.2

Same Updraft as 0.8.1. The only change is behind the scenes: the download now has a name that never changes, so the link on the website always gets the newest version.

### Fixed
- **Fixed: one download link for good.** The newest installer is always `Updraft-Setup.exe` (Windows) and `Updraft-Mac.dmg` (Mac). Updates work the same as before.
